mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, I.ORDER_ITEM_ID, I.ORDER_ITEM_PRICE, I.ORDER_ITEM_QTY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.IMAGE_SAVED_NAME FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM I ON O.ORDER_ID = I.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ORDER_STATUS = 'READY'
